tasks.subject: Task 1: Project scaffold, Inputs window and sample tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The sample project exists in the solution. Its Inputs window covers checkbox (incl. indeterminate select-all and disabled), number (int and double), radio (vertical and segmented) and separators, and it builds and works under test.

**Files:**
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo.csproj`
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/plugin.json`
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/packages.neutral.lock.json` (generated by restore)
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/ControlsDemoPlugin.cs`
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/InputsBinding.cs`
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/inputs.xml`
- Modify: `AcDream.slnx` (the `/samples/` folder)
- Modify: `tests/AcDream.App.Tests/AcDream.App.Tests.csproj` (project reference) and its `packages.neutral.lock.json` (restore adds the project entry)
- Test: `tests/AcDream.App.Tests/UI/ControlsDemoSampleTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `dotnet build AcDream.slnx -c Release` → 0 warnings, 0 errors, and the sample's output folder holds `AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo.dll`, `plugin.json` and `inputs.xml`.
- [ ] `inputs.xml` builds and draws under Classic, Moss and Brass, and every non-label child lies inside the window.
- [ ] Clicking "Everything below" while the pickups are mixed ticks all three. Clicking "Rares" afterwards makes `AllPickups` null (indeterminate).
- [ ] The test project's lock file gains only the `acdream.plugins.controlsdemo` project entry.

**Verify:** `dotnet test tests/AcDream.App.Tests/AcDream.App.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~ControlsDemoSample` → `Passed!`, 0 failed.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Layout window
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A resizable window with a remembered horizontal split. The left pane is a list. The right pane holds a remembered (named, unbound) expander, a bound expander with a nested remembered expander inside, and a status line that moves up when they fold.

**Files:**
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/LayoutBinding.cs`
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/layout.xml`
- Modify: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/ControlsDemoPlugin.cs` (one `Add`)
- Test: `tests/AcDream.App.Tests/UI/ControlsDemoSampleTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `layout.xml` builds and draws in all three themes, inside the window.
- [ ] A click on the bound "Advanced (bound)" header calls `SetAdvancedOpen(false)`: `AdvancedOpen` becomes false and `Status` reads `Advanced folded`.
- [ ] A click on the unbound "General" header calls `GeneralChanged(false)` → `Status` `General folded`.

**Verify:** `dotnet test tests/AcDream.App.Tests/AcDream.App.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~ControlsDemoSample` → `Passed!`.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Table window
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A resizable window with a named multi-select list. It has a header, sortable text/number columns (one with `sortkeys`), resizable columns, a select-all checkbox column, a button column and a row context menu. "Remove selected" asks with `Confirm` before it removes anything.

- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/table.xml`

- Test: `tests/AcDream.App.Tests/UI/ControlsDemoSampleTests.cs` (adds the `FakeUi` helper)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `table.xml` builds and draws in all three themes, inside the window.
- [ ] `KeepAll(true)` ticks every row. The context menu's "Don't keep" (index 1) clears the selected rows only.
- [ ] `RemoveSelected` with rows 1 and 3 selected sends one `Confirm` with buttons `Remove|Keep` and `OwnerView` `table`. Answer 0 removes exactly those two rows and clears the selection. Answer 1 removes nothing and sets `Status` to `Nothing removed`.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Dialogs window and modal editor
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A Dialogs window with:
- message boxes with the default buttons, three buttons and four buttons;
- an unowned (screen-centred) box, and two queued boxes;
- a context menu on its "Edit profile..." button.

That button opens a hidden `editor` window with `ShowModal(..., "dialogs")`. The editor edits a draft and hides itself on Save or Cancel.

**Files:**
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/Profile.cs`
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/DialogsBinding.cs`
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/EditorBinding.cs`
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/dialogs.xml`
- Create: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/editor.xml`
- Modify: `samples/AcDream.Plugins.ControlsDemo/ControlsDemoPlugin.cs` (two `Add`s; remove the `// Later windows` comment)
- Test: `tests/AcDream.App.Tests/UI/ControlsDemoSampleTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `dialogs.xml` and `editor.xml` build and draw in all three themes, inside their windows.
- [ ] "Three buttons" sends a `Confirm` owned by `dialogs` with `Save|Discard|Cancel`. Answer 1 sets `Status` to `Unsaved changes: Discard`.
- [ ] "Queue two" sends two dialogs with the same owner.
- [ ] "Edit profile..." calls `ShowModal("editor", "dialogs")`. Editing the name then Save updates `ProfileSummary` and hides `editor`. Cancel hides it and leaves the profile unchanged.
- [ ] Context menu "Reset profile" (index 1) asks `Reset|Keep`. Answer 0 restores the defaults.
- [ ] The editor registers with `StartVisible = false` and `ShowInSidePanel = false`.

**Verify:** `dotnet test tests/AcDream.App.Tests/AcDream.App.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~ControlsDemoSample` → `Passed!`.

tasks.subject: Task 8: Live check
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every demo window works in the real client, on the local ACE server, at 2x, in Classic and in a plugin theme. The user drives the client and reports what they see; the controller records what passed.

> **USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:** none changed (findings become new fix tasks; nothing is fixed in this task).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The user said they are available before the client was launched.
- [ ] The client log shows `sample.controls-demo` loaded with no markup build error for any of its 7 windows.
- [ ] The user confirms each window in Classic and in one modern theme. The status lines show the documented callbacks:
  - Inputs: select-all dash; number commit/spin/wheel; radio arrows after Tab.
  - Keys and colours: record, Escape, Backspace; picker drag, Escape, hex.
  - Layout: split drag remembered after a relog; "General" fold remembered.
  - Table: sort, resize, double-click reset, Ctrl/Shift-click, select-all, context menu, Remove confirm.
  - Tree: arrows, Left/Right, expansion remembered, branch menu.
  - Dialogs: every button; Escape answers last; owner blocked while other windows, chat and movement work; editor modal.
- [ ] Each defect is recorded with window, theme and steps. None is fixed inside this task.
